primary_endpoint: Percentage of responders with disappearance of steatohepatitis without worsening of fibrosis from baseline to Week 52.
efficacy_outcome: Reported p-values were 0.8539 and 0.8160 (logistic regression); no significant difference was reported. The results list response counts and denominators, but their pairing is unclear.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 12/93 with GFT505 80 mg, 14/89 with GFT505 120 mg, and 9/92 with placebo; no deaths.
